issues.problem: A standalone analysis URL takes precedence over a visible running game clock. The panel accepts the retained live board during a simulated staggered SPA transition.
issues.fix: Evaluate active-game evidence for the current main board before accepting the analysis route. Test URL and board changes in separate steps and assert no launcher or outbound ask while the running clock remains.

issues.problem: Detected-side fallback sends an undisclosed en passant target after a double push even when the canonical position has no legal en passant capture.
issues.fix: Use the same legal en passant rule as replay when synthesizing the board FEN. Show when the field is inferred and cover both an available and unavailable capture with full outbound FEN assertions.

issues.problem: Explain skips exact comparison to the request root at zero preceding plies. A reply with the wrong captured piece can pass the footprint check and render.
issues.fix: Compare the returned position to req.fen when the preceding SAN list is empty. Retain the click-time footprint check and add the first-move capture regression with a different piece on the capture square.

issues.problem: Closed-panel confirmation performs layout reads on a gate transition. Open-panel animation handling can retain an old ask for about a second.
issues.fix: Keep launcher confirmation layout-free and defer full position reads to panel open and ask time. Replace moving-board ask controls with a disabled reading state within the update budget. Instrument the whole launcher tick on both quiet and changed pages.

issues.problem: Try the other server from bad_response can repeat the server that just failed when an older successful answer came from the backup.
issues.fix: Send the failed attempt's server with the typed error and use that identity to order the alternative. Add a regression with earlier backup success followed by a primary format failure.

issues.problem: No study fixture combines a selected custom-start line with an exposed root FEN.
issues.fix: Add a lila-derived study with a tagged nonstandard start and a selected move after at least one preceding ply. Assert its identity, Explain label, all six root FEN fields, and ordered outbound SAN.

issues.problem: Empty settings live regions are removed from the accessibility tree before the first validation or save message.
issues.fix: Keep the live-region nodes exposed while empty. Exercise first-error, save, and removal announcements in a documented screen-reader walkthrough.

issues.problem: The panel's 600-second countdown limit and the worker's 86,400-second parser limit diverge from the provider's Retry-After interval.
issues.fix: Pass the worker's expiry time to the panel and use it for countdown and enablement. Test a valid interval above 600 seconds and a valid HTTP-date response.

issues.problem: Scanned-board results strip numbering from every supplied critical line.
issues.fix: Use accurate absolute numbering when available and label numbering as relative to the asked position when historical clocks are unknown.

issues.problem: The owner dashboard-check screenshot required for level 10 is absent.
issues.fix: After the release blockers are resolved, attach the passing dashboard draft screenshot and identify the package version it covers.
